instructions: Road stories for debate offense (humanize) and defense (credibility). County labels marked INTERPRETATION until Kelly confirms on tape. Claims gate before broadcast.

storySlots.title: County clerk who called on Friday afternoon
storySlots.county: Saline County area (INTERPRETATION — confirm with Kelly)
storySlots.story: A county election official described getting a new mandate from Little Rock on a Friday with no training budget and no named SOS contact — they asked who would answer the phone Monday. That is why I am running the office as service, not as another rule from the Capitol.
storySlots.whenToUse: County questions, SOS-as-service bridge, county-champion trap lane, implementation dare
storySlots.offensiveUse: Pair with Act 350 or 444 — unfunded mandate without SOS training.
storySlots.defensiveUse: Shows Kelly listens; avoids attacking Hammer personally.

storySlots.title: Petition volunteer turned away
storySlots.story: A lawful petition volunteer said the signature rules were so confusing they stopped a drive — not because of fraud, but because the process felt like a trap. Integrity and participation should work together; the Secretary of State should publish rules people can read.
storySlots.whenToUse: Direct democracy / Hammer petition record, integrity-without-participation trap
storySlots.offensiveUse: After fraud-data-dare if he has no conviction numbers.

storySlots.title: Quorum court member worried about unfunded mandate
storySlots.story: A quorum court member asked where the line item was for the newest election law — their clerk had been told to comply first and ask questions later. That is centralized government in practice: Little Rock authors, counties pay.
storySlots.whenToUse: Implementation vs authorship, county-champion trap, 2021 vs 2025 pivot
storySlots.offensiveUse: Supports county-burden theme in theme matrix.
storySlots.defensiveUse: Rural audience credibility — fiscal conservatism angle.

storySlots.title: Young voter first time participating
storySlots.story: A first-time voter said they wanted election rules they could find online — not slogans about integrity. Transparency is a kitchen-table issue; as Secretary of State I will publish guidance voters and volunteers can verify.
storySlots.whenToUse: Trust / transparency pillar, opening/closing trust line
storySlots.offensiveUse: Kelly superiority — non-partisan service for all voters.
storySlots.defensiveUse: Positive frame when debate gets negative.

storySlots.title: Election worker overtime
storySlots.story: Poll workers described absorbing new procedures after another session of election bills — without extra staff or state training. The Secretary of State should show up with a training calendar, not blame counties when lines get long.
storySlots.whenToUse: Humanize county burden vs Hammer record, county theme bills
storySlots.offensiveUse: Pairs with SB487 precinct changes (2021 package).
storySlots.defensiveUse: Electoral workers as heroes — Kelly ally frame.

storySlots.title: Republican county meeting — tired of division
storySlots.story: In a room that was mostly Republican and independent, voters said they wanted a Secretary of State who works across the aisle and keeps the office non-partisan — not another culture-war headline. When I said transparency and accountability would be day one, the room reacted strongly. That is the campaign we are running.
storySlots.whenToUse: Unity drill-down, opening/closing, civic education question, any 'division in politics' moderator angle
storySlots.claimsStatus: INTERPRETATION — field-tested tone; confirm venue on tape before naming county
storySlots.offensiveUse: Lean into tested themes without attacking voter tribes.
storySlots.defensiveUse: Shows Kelly is not a partisan bomb-thrower.

storySlots.title: Civic Index last in the nation
storySlots.story: The Arkansas Civic Index ranks Arkansas last in civic health in this country. That is not an attack line — it is accountability on the administration of the Secretary of State. I will educate the public and measure progress so we climb off the bottom.
storySlots.whenToUse: Turnout question, civic education drill-down, closing accountability beat
storySlots.claimsStatus: NEEDS_REVIEW — verify index source/year before broadcast
storySlots.offensiveUse: Administration results frame vs Hammer authorship.

storySlots.title: Clerk asked about Act 768 before it was clear
storySlots.story: A clerk asked how local initiative petitions change under the newest act before anyone at the state had published plain-language guidance — volunteers and counties were left guessing. I will not add another bill without a training plan and a hotline that answers.
storySlots.defensiveUse: Shows Kelly plans implementation, not just criticism.
